data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 这张的鼓听起来很棒
data.description: 唱片店试听区前，虹夏把耳机的一边稍稍移开，举起正在听的唱片封套给你看。她想说的第一件事，果然还是里面的鼓。
data.promptProse: At a record-store listening station, Nijika wears a mustard jacket over a striped shirt and denim pinafore. She lifts one headphone cup off her ear while showing a record sleeve to the viewer. Warm shelf lights illuminate the vinyl bins around her.
data.animaCaption: One hand moves the headphone cup; the other supports the lower edge of the record sleeve.
data.action: 移开一边耳机，举起唱片封套给你看
